items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number,
items.claim: Moses shall take a census of the children of Israel
items.object: the sum of the children of Israel

items.quote: then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them;
items.claim: Each of the children of Israel shall give a ransom for his soul to the LORD during a census

items.quote: that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
items.claim: The ransom payment prevents plague among the children of Israel during numbering
